aboutText: Located at 67 St Hellier St, Heidelberg Heights, CoCraft Melbourne offers woodworking classes and memberships for all skill levels. Our community-oriented approach provides a welcoming space to learn and create with expert guidance. Memberships offer cost-effective ways to spend more time making in our fully equipped studio during opening hours.
servicesText: Our classes cover a range of skills from basic techniques to advanced projects. Memberships provide ongoing access to our workshop for independent practice and creativity.

services.title: Beginner Classes
services.desc: Perfect for those new to woodworking, covering tools and basic techniques in a supportive environment.

services.title: Advanced Workshops
services.desc: For experienced makers looking to refine skills in joinery, furniture making, and complex projects.

services.title: Membership Access
services.desc: Enjoy flexible studio hours with affordable membership plans for regular practice.

services.title: Private Tuition
services.desc: One-on-one sessions tailored to your specific projects and learning goals.

services.title: Tool Training
services.desc: Learn to use various woodworking tools safely and effectively for better results.

services.title: Community Projects
services.desc: Collaborate with others in group projects and events to build skills together.
